cover.prompt: Inside the tranquil open-air reading alcove of the coastal library, scholar sits in peaceful solitary concentration at a sunlit stone desk, writing independently on a papyrus scroll with stylus poised and elbows held wide; in the midground outside the colonnade, librarian walks along the paved terrace in a measured contact stride with scroll tucked under her arm, leaving scholar completely isolated in his private workspace; the carved limestone doorframe of the alcove anchors the left margin; the colonnade extends outward at a 35 degree diagonal, illuminated by warm late-day sun that casts razor-sharp shadows across the Pentelic marble paving, with the open sky filling the upper frame.
cover.others: neat rows of papyrus scrolls in the recessed wall cubicles.
